digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate + gerrit review-bot det criterion
propositions: Complex bug fixes (non-test file changes) bypass substantive review under the light advisory tier and ship with only advisory det findings; escalation to full blocking rubric is needed when file_impact enumerates non-test paths.

Bug fixes exceeding 150 non-test lines lack a gate preventing landing without a current plan-review attestation; gerrit det criterion must block oversized bug fixes with missing or stale attestations.

Plan-review attestations cannot be verified cross-host (on review-bot distinct from review environment) using own-env plan_review_status; cross-host verification requires opcert machinery and trusted-environment keyring lookup.

Verdict classification for attestation freshness must distinguish accepted states (certified, stale-code, stale-head), flag states (malformed, replayed, unpinned, era-invalid), and infra-fail-open states (unavailable, read errors, unknown future verdicts).

Non-test line classification rule (tests/** and conftest.py excluded; everything else counted) and 150-line threshold must be stated once as a shared constant and applied consistently in both the blast-radius logic and backtest validation.

Backtest over 113 historical bug-fix commits must achieve exact set equality: flagged set == 13 hand-adjudicated substantive commits, with zero mechanical false positives from rename/move/format-only/generated changes.
